Use the cited passage to explain: What makes the borrowed armour important?

armor.author: Homer
armor.locator: Book 16, Achilles lends Patroclus his armour; Book 16, normalized characters 3336-3687
armor.excerpt: now gird my armour about your shoulders, and lead the Myrmidons to battle, for the dark cloud of Trojans has burst furiously over our fleet; the Argives are driven back on to the beach, cooped within a narrow space, and the whole people of Troy has taken heart to sally out against them, because they see not the visor of my helmet gleaming near them.
armor.note: Verbatim local text with whitespace normalized. This Book 16 passage records Achilles' instructions before Patroclus enters the fight.

narrativeBlocks.title: Achilles lends his armour
narrativeBlocks.body: Achilles tells Patroclus to wear his armour and lead the Myrmidons against the Trojans. This is a temporary substitution, not a transfer of Achilles' whole identity or fate.

narrativeBlocks.title: The messenger brings news
narrativeBlocks.body: Source quotation from Book 18 (Butler translation; whitespace normalized): “Patroclus has fallen, and a fight is raging about his naked body”

narrativeBlocks.title: The equipment has a limit
narrativeBlocks.body: Book 16 says Patroclus wears Achilles' armour but does not take Achilles' spear, which no other Achaean can wield. Keep that detail attached to this episode.

narrativeBlocks.title: Grief changes the situation
narrativeBlocks.body: Antilochus reports Patroclus' death and Hector's possession of the armour. The poem describes Achilles' grief before showing how he responds; do not collapse these steps into an instant cure.

narrativeBlocks.title: Carry it forward
narrativeBlocks.body: These passages connect a borrowed role in Book 16 with the cost of Patroclus' death in Book 18.

quiz.prompt: What news does Antilochus bring Achilles?

choices.text: Patroclus has fallen, and Hector holds his armour

quiz.explanation: Antilochus reports Patroclus' death and says Hector holds his armour.

quiz.prompt: Which item does Patroclus not take because no other Achaean can wield it?
quiz.explanation: Book 16 says Patroclus does not take the spear because none of the other Achaeans can wield it.
